name: SerpApi image search
description: Finds pictures for automatic image layers in generated promos and overlays ("{up_next} main character png") from Google Images results, through SerpApi. Needs a SerpApi account; each query is only searched for once, and what's found is kept.
author: SchedularrTV

settings.label: API key
settings.placeholder: From serpapi.com › Your account › API key
settings.description: Stored in plain text in the settings file, readable by anyone who can open your data folder. SERPAPI_API_KEY in the environment is used when this is empty. Each new query uses one search from your SerpApi plan.

settings.label: Safe search
settings.description: Leaves explicit pictures out of the results. Recommended for anything that airs.

settings.label: Country
settings.description: Two-letter country code Google searches from, which can change what's found.
